description: Look up a US patent's maintenance-fee history and in-force/expired status: every recorded maintenance-fee event (payments, surcharges, expiration for non-payment, reinstatement, entity-status changes) plus a computed status and a 4th/8th/12th-year fee-window breakdown (due date, grace-period end, whether paid). Give the patent number with or without commas ("10835610" or "10,835,610"). Design (D-prefixed) and plant (PP-prefixed) patents are statutorily exempt from maintenance fees and will report subject_to_maintenance_fees:false rather than a bare no-match. Sourced from USPTO's Patent Maintenance Fee Events (public domain, covers patents granted 1981-09-01 to present), refreshed from the weekly bulk file — every response carries data_as_of. Keyless. Does NOT determine full-term (20-year) expiration or any non-fee reason a patent could be invalid — this pack covers maintenance-fee lapses only; pair with the `patents` pack for prosecution history.

patent_number.description: US patent number, with or without commas, e.g. "10835610" or "10,835,610". Reissue numbers keep their "RE" prefix, e.g. "RE12345".

name: get_patent_maintenance_status
title: Get Patent Maintenance Status
